question: Zeeshan travels 364 km at 91 km/hr, the next 441 km at 63 km/hr and the next 648 km at 81 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed is the ratio of total distance to total time.

Total Distance = 364 + 441 + 648 = 1453 km

Total Time = (364 ÷ 91) + (441 ÷ 63) + (648 ÷ 81)

Total Time = 4 + 7 + 8 = 19 hours

Average Speed = 1453 ÷ 19 ≈ 76.47 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 76.47 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 (D₁) = 364 km, Speed 1 (S₁) = 91 km/hr

Distance 2 (D₂) = 441 km, Speed 2 (S₂) = 63 km/hr

Distance 3 (D₃) = 648 km, Speed 3 (S₃) = 81 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = D₁ + D₂ + D₃

⇒ Total Distance = 364 + 441 + 648 = 1453 km

⇒ Time for part 1 (T₁) = 364 ÷ 91 = 4 hours

⇒ Time for part 2 (T₂) = 441 ÷ 63 = 7 hours

⇒ Time for part 3 (T₃) = 648 ÷ 81 = 8 hours

⇒ Total Time = T₁ + T₂ + T₃

⇒ Total Time = 4 + 7 + 8 = 19 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 1453 ÷ 19

⇒ Average Speed = 76.4736... km/hr

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 76.47 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 76.47 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is defined as the total distance travelled divided by the total time taken. Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, then the average speed is directly given by the formula: (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Conversion of Speed Units

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
